input.free_text_description: The system operates in the file management, authentication domain. It serves Admin, System, User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include admin, article, del note. Core business data revolves around ArticleDo, DelNoteDo, EditorConfigReq, NotePreviewInfo. The system enforces access control and identity verification for protected operations.

user_stories.story: As a Admin, I want to upload and manage files, so that I can store and retrieve documents as needed.
As a Admin, I want to manage user accounts and profiles, so that user information stays current and accurate.
As a Admin, I want to manage admin operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a Admin, I want to manage article operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a Admin, I want to manage del note operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
